crossRefs.note: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me…
Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Sing to Yahweh! Praise Yahweh, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.
Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

translations.web: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
translations.bsb: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
translations.kjv: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph
translations.asv: By this I know that thou delightest in me, Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
